reason: In packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts:53,62,85-94, biginAuth extracts credential.id into credentialId and refreshAccessToken passes credentialId as the third argument to refreshOAuthTokens. Because packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts:3,11 expects userId as its third parameter and posts it as calcomUserId to CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, the sync endpoint receives the credential ID instead of credential.userId.
